question.prompt: \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\) are congruent, with \(\angle A=\angle E\), \(\angle B=\angle D\), and \(\angle C=\angle F\). Complete the congruence statement △ABC≌△___ with corresponding vertices in order.

solutions.explanation: \(A\) corresponds to \(E\), \(B\) corresponds to \(D\), and \(C\) corresponds to \(F\), so \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle EDF\).
solutions.title: Write vertices in corresponding order
